method_notes: Latency samples are OS-cache-warm. Matrix/A0/A1/B/C/D are process/allocator-warm within each ignored release test; E1/E2 setup, exact-A1, and reuse each execute in separate fresh child processes, with child-internal timings and process-wall timings reported separately.
RSS samples run each arm in a fresh direct release-test child and use macOS /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set size bytes plus a steady ps sample.

Fixture generation and initial materialization occur outside timed admission samples. E1/E2 sidecar setup executes in a separate child that exits before paired sampling. E2 validated reuse and full_git_snapshot_a1_us each include an independent Git identity check, object pin, and exact-snapshot materialization.

A0 and A1 host samples start from the same filesystem source and report the same physical source bytes read; every A0 parser, nesting, record, AST, reference, and dependency counter aggregates its admission plus ordinary-load decode.
Matrix source SHA-256 values are framed hashes of the exact 18-file canonical source tree.

A0/A1/C/F timing and RSS rows were regenerated at 4ed7f994 after the cancellation and dependency-edge accounting corrections; D rows were regenerated at 8ce55419 after per-observation pinning; A0 aggregate logical-decode counters were corrected at 607e920; admitted A0/A1 outputs were wired to the accepted calculation and workspace oracles and metadata reads gained cancellation boundaries at d3edb03; accepted semantic validation gained internal cancellation polling at b31d142; at 878e62c ordinary production validation was restored exactly to main while controlled traversal was isolated behind the research feature. After mechanical reconciliation with main c3b5ad2, B/E1/E2 alone were regenerated at 01ef8dc: B now measures the bounded token path for both successful interference and cancellation; E1/E2 use fresh setup/A1/reuse child processes, counterbalanced pair order, explicit PIDs, monotonic validated-reuse/full-open timing, and process-wall timing. A0/A1/C/D/F were not rerun because the final correction does not materially change their timed non-cancelled paths or evidence contracts.

D first_exact_bounded_us samples a fresh complete source pin plus the first materialization in every repetition; repeated_materialize_us is a separate immediately repeated lookup on that same pinned snapshot.

The earlier 1b3d75de and bd115c8 captures, concurrently launched or interrupted exploratory E2 runs, and HOLD-era unpushed d527238 recaptures were discarded; no superseded row is present in the committed CSV files.
The sidecar is a JSON envelope, not SQLite; sidecar_bytes is the complete serialized JSON byte length and there are no WAL/SHM files.

Validated E1/E2 reuse rejects an envelope above an eight-times-source-plus-1-MiB byte budget (also globally capped at 512 MiB) before UTF-8/JSON parsing, pins all 18 source files, independently re-derives the complete Structural Index, and compares every sidecar fact before reuse. Setup, exact-A1, and reuse run in separate fresh processes; A1 receives no sidecar path/state. E2 resolves HEAD once per child, then reads the exact Git blob object IDs bound by object format, captured commit, tree, path, and mode; it does not derive trusted facts from the mutable worktree. E2 full_git_snapshot_a1_us independently repeats Git identity and blob pinning, materializes those exact bytes, and runs exact A1 admission. Identity-plus-decode remains a non-authoritative decomposition metric; total_validated_reuse_us and full_sidecar_open_us are monotonic child-side measurements.

B alternates baseline_then_background and background_then_baseline order, waits for at least 64 completed entity records while asserting that the background worker remains active, and records arm_order plus the observed background_started_after_records in every raw row. Both successful and cancelled background workers use the controlled bounded token path; the counterbalanced p95 ratio fails the 10 percent foreground-regression gate.

Background A1 reads manifest and schemas through unbounded but cancellation-polled chunks and checks cancellation before and after metadata parsing and canonical rendering; this preserves exact admission size semantics.

Background A1 uses a research-feature-only copy of the accepted semantic validator with cancellation polling at schema, entity, field, and formula-node boundaries; ordinary non-cancellable production validation remains exactly on the main implementation path.

Controlled background entity records poll cancellation during bounded reads, fail closed above a 64 KiB post-read work budget to exact foreground admission, and check cancellation after UTF-8, strict inspection, DTO decode, work counting, canonical rendering, and semantic conversion. Deterministic tests prove cancellation after a completed large-record read and no SemanticCurrent publication.
No failed or cancelled measurement row was silently removed. Cancellation outcomes are explicit in progressive-background-raw.csv.

row_context.fixture_join: Derive experiment from fixture_experiment_by_artifact, apply any declared fixture_column_aliases_by_artifact, then join each raw row to fixture-manifest.csv by experiment/workload/entities/source_sha256; where a raw source_sha256 is absent, use the matching literal unknown fixture row. Inherit exact measurement_head and base_head from artifact_provenance_by_artifact for the containing raw artifact.
row_context.explicit_outcome_exception: progressive-background-raw.csv records cancellation_outcome=cancelled for every cancellation-pressure row.
row_context.oracle_status: The actual A0 and A1 admitted outputs are exactly equal to their source Documents under success, cold numeric mutation, SCC, and evaluation-failure pressure, and each output is fed directly to calculate_complete and workspace validation stable_observations for comparison with the source oracle. C/D never claim SemanticCurrent and return requires_full_admission for unsupported formula/validation proof.
row_context.phase_boundary: HostReady is the already-running release test process and is excluded; no shell/UI milestone is measured. SourceKnown, first source preview, SemanticCurrent, bounded-result, scan, sidecar, cancellation, and RSS fields are explicit where applicable.
row_context.unknown_metadata: Unknown values are the literal unknown in fixture-manifest.csv; no unavailable per-row metadata is inferred.
